title: Just a Fun Project
author: Long_Meringue_6974
selftext: I started a fun project a few weeks ago to test the capabilities of Arena Ai and built an algo trader,One thing led to another and now I have a python algotrader which makes 10% a week and most intresting thing is it's Max drawdown since there wasn't a single week it was Negative.Never went below it's starting capital and good enough WR and avgP avgL . Though it's still a paper and I still invested 100+ hrs on this final build(not counting 8+ prototypes).Can someone let me know if there's something wrong with it which is a mirage of profit or have I actually found an edge.Also profit is after all fees and without fees it made over 11% but since it's frequency is high (30 trades/day) it does tend to pay high fees.
